2356	-- Bounds (in seconds) of the Nth transcription window. Windows after the
2357	-- first start MEETING_OVERLAP_SECONDS earlier than the previous one ended,
2358	-- giving whisper context across word boundaries.
2359	local function meetingWindowBounds(idx)
2360	    if idx == 1 then return 0, MEETING_CHUNK_SECONDS end
2361	    local startSec = MEETING_CHUNK_SECONDS * (idx - 1) - MEETING_OVERLAP_SECONDS
2362	    local endSec   = MEETING_CHUNK_SECONDS * idx
2363	    return startSec, endSec
2364	end

2366	-- Remove the duplicated overlap region from the start of `curr`. Whisper's
2367	-- output for the same audio shifts with context, so an exact suffix/prefix
2368	-- match almost never fires. Instead: search for the last K words of `prev`
2369	-- anywhere in the first half of `curr`, and strip everything up to and
2370	-- including that match. K decreases from 6 down to 3 to allow for word
2371	-- drops; below 3 false-positive risk on common phrases is too high.
2372	local function stripOverlap(prev, curr)
2373	    if prev == "" or curr == "" then return curr end
2374	    local function words(s)
2375	        local out = {}
2376	        for w in s:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(out, w) end
2377	        return out
2378	    end
2379	    local function norm(w)
2380	        local s = w:lower():gsub("^[%p]+", ""):gsub("[%p]+$", "")
2381	        return s  -- discard gsub's replacement-count second return value
2382	    end
2383	    local p, c = words(prev), words(curr)
2384	    if #p < 3 or #c < 3 then return curr end
2385	    local searchLimit = math.min(#c - 1, math.max(8, math.floor(#c * 0.6)))
2386	    for k = math.min(6, #p), 3, -1 do
2387	        local tail = {}
2388	        for i = #p - k + 1, #p do table.insert(tail, norm(p[i])) end
2389	        for startPos = 1, searchLimit - k + 1 do
2390	            local match = true
2391	            for j = 1, k do
2392	                if norm(c[startPos + j - 1]) ~= tail[j] then match = false; break end
2393	            end
2394	            if match then
2395	                local out = {}
2396	                for i = startPos + k, #c do table.insert(out, c[i]) end
2397	                return table.concat(out, " ")
2398	            end
2399	        end
2400	    end
2401	    return curr
2402	end

2547	-- Enqueue a window job and inc the pending count up front (so save logic
2548	-- waits for it). Actual slicing+whisper runs serialized via processNextWindow.
2549	local function enqueueWindow(idx, startSec, endSec)
2550	    meetingPendingTranscriptions = meetingPendingTranscriptions + 1
2551	    table.insert(meetingWindowQueue, { idx = idx, startSec = startSec, endSec = endSec })
2552	end

2554	-- Tick: enqueue any windows whose audio has fully arrived in recording.pcm.
2555	local function emitReadyWindows()
2556	    if not meetingRecording and not meetingStopping then return end
2557	    local attr = hs.fs.attributes(meetingPcmPath)
2558	    if not attr or attr.size <= 0 then return end
2559	    local recordedSec = attr.size / MEETING_PCM_BYTES_PER_SEC
2560	    local startSec, endSec = meetingWindowBounds(meetingNextWindowIdx)
2561	    while recordedSec >= endSec do
2562	        log(string.format("meeting: enqueue window %d [%.1f, %.1f] (recorded %.1fs, queue=%d, processing=%s)",
2563	            meetingNextWindowIdx, startSec, endSec, recordedSec,
2564	            #meetingWindowQueue, tostring(meetingProcessing)))
2565	        enqueueWindow(meetingNextWindowIdx, startSec, endSec)
2566	        meetingNextWindowIdx = meetingNextWindowIdx + 1
2567	        startSec, endSec = meetingWindowBounds(meetingNextWindowIdx)
2568	    end
2569	    processNextWindow()
2570	end

2572	-- Stop-time flush: enqueue one last partial window for [next.start, recording-end).
2573	local function emitFinalPartialWindow()
2574	    if meetingStopFlushed then return end
2575	    meetingStopFlushed = true
2576	    local attr = hs.fs.attributes(meetingPcmPath)
2577	    if not attr or attr.size <= 0 then return end
2578	    local recordedSec = attr.size / MEETING_PCM_BYTES_PER_SEC
2579	    local startSec, _ = meetingWindowBounds(meetingNextWindowIdx)
2580	    if recordedSec - startSec < 1.0 then return end  -- skip tail under 1s
2581	    enqueueWindow(meetingNextWindowIdx, startSec, recordedSec)
2582	    meetingNextWindowIdx = meetingNextWindowIdx + 1
2583	    processNextWindow()
2584	end
